singleCardMassDialog.title: Add cards to wishlist
singleCardMassDialog.description: Each card must be in its own line. Please enter the number of cards (optional), the name, the set code in brackets (optional) and the collector number (optional).

importDialog.title: Import Wants from file
importDialog.description1: The file must be a CSV file containing the following columns: uuid, name, setCodes, language, quality, quantity, foil, altered, signed, misprint, graded, price, comment.
importDialog.description2: Either the field "uuid" or "name" are required for each line. All other fields are optional. (See example file)
importDialog.description3: After the upload, you will get a chance to preview the cards before finalizing the import.
importDialog.errorRequiredMissing: Either uuid or name are required
importDialog.manaboxDescription1: Upload the CSV file that an export from the ManaBox app gerenates.
